title: The Gilded Debt
description: A counting-house that lends to anybody and collects from everybody,
run by three patrons who agree on nothing except the interest. The
ledger is open. The ledger is always open. That is the point of a
ledger and the problem with a ledger.
Mechanically this group is where the collection keeps its money
habits: a chapter whose item tasks take what they ask for by
default, a repeatable collection round on a cooldown, an OR-gate,
an exclusive pair of patrons, a scoreboard the house scores its
clients in, and every way a reward can be paid -- once per team,
picked by the player, rolled with a bonus, skipped if already
carried, held back from Claim all, pushed past a payout block, or
run as a command that tells the whole server about it.
Read it for: the consume ladder, `repeatable` + `repeatCooldownTicks`,
